svg.text: ② az deployment group create (infra/main.bicep) → creates every resource + role
③ az ml data / compute / job / model create
⑥ az ml model download → model.pkl

① push code ② create Azure resources with Bicep ③ upload data and train in Azure ML ④ or train from a GitHub button ⑤ GitHub logs in without a password ⑥ get the registered model ⑦ push the image ⑧ deploy a new revision ⑨ app pulls the image with its identity ⑩ users call the API
